title: CyberWar, CyberTerror, CyberCrime: A Guide to the Role of Standards in an Environment of Change and Danger
description: This book gives you a stark and timely analysis of the hostile online landscape that today's corporate systems inhabit, providing CIOs and IT professionals with a practical introduction to the defensive strategies that you can be employed in response.
translatedDescription: Este libro le da un análisis escalofriante y oportuno del paisaje en línea hostil que habitan los sistemas corporativos de hoy, proporcionando CIOs y profesionales de TI una introducción práctica a las estrategias defensivas que se pueden emplear en respuesta.

title: Think Like an Entrepreneur, Act Like a CEO
description: Education plus experience once guaranteed a successful career, but no more! Today, success depends on your ability to adapt. You must be agile, willing to adjust your professional expectations, and able to respond quickly to opportunities and threats.
translatedDescription: La educación y la experiencia garantizan una carrera exitosa, ¡pero ya no! Hoy, el éxito depende de su capacidad de adaptación. Usted debe ser ágil, dispuesto a ajustar sus expectativas profesionales, y capaz de responder rápidamente a oportunidades y amenazas.

title: Cyber Reconnaissance, Surveillance and Defense
description:
At a time when online surveillance and cybercrime techniques are widespread, and are being used by governments, corporations, and individuals, Cyber Reconnaissance, Surveillance and Defense gives you a practical resource that explains how these activities are being carried out and shows how to defend against them.

Expert author Rob Shimonski shows you how to carry out advanced IT surveillance and reconnaissance, describes when and how these techniques are used, and provides a full legal background for each threat. To help you understand how to defend against these attacks, this book describes many new and leading-edge surveillance, information-gathering, and personal exploitation threats taking place today, including Web cam breaches, home privacy systems, physical and logical tracking, phone tracking, picture metadata, physical device tracking and geo-location, social media security, identity theft, social engineering, sniffing, and more.

Understand how IT surveillance and reconnaissance techniques are being used to track and monitor activities of individuals and organizations
Find out about the legal basis of these attacks and threats — what is legal and what is not — and how to defend against any type of surveillance
Learn how to thwart monitoring and surveillance threats with practical tools and techniques
Real-world examples teach using key concepts from cases in the news around the world
translatedDescription:
En un momento en que las técnicas de vigilancia en línea y cibercrimen son generalizadas, y están siendo utilizadas por gobiernos, corporaciones e individuos, Cyber Reconnaissance, Vigilancia y Defensa le da un recurso práctico que explica cómo se están llevando a cabo estas actividades y muestra cómo defenderlas.

El autor de expertos Rob Shimonski le muestra cómo realizar vigilancia y reconocimiento avanzados de TI, describe cuándo y cómo se utilizan estas técnicas y proporciona un fondo jurídico completo para cada amenaza. Para ayudarle a entender cómo defenderse de estos ataques, este libro describe muchas nuevas y de vanguardia de vigilancia, reunión de información y amenazas de explotación personal que tienen lugar hoy, incluyendo brechas de cámara web, sistemas de privacidad en el hogar, seguimiento físico y lógico, seguimiento de teléfonos, metadatos de imágenes, seguimiento de dispositivos físicos y geolocalización, seguridad de las redes sociales, robo de identidad, ingeniería social, olfato y más.

Comprender cómo se utilizan técnicas de vigilancia y reconocimiento de TI para rastrear y supervisar las actividades de individuos y organizaciones
Conocer la base legal de estos ataques y amenazas —lo que es legal y lo que no es— y cómo defenderse contra cualquier tipo de vigilancia
Aprender a frustrar las amenazas de monitoreo y vigilancia con herramientas y técnicas prácticas
Ejemplos del mundo real enseñan usando conceptos clave de casos en las noticias alrededor del mundo

title: Critical Infrastructure System Security and Resiliency
description: With an emphasis on protecting an infrastructure's ability to perform its mission or function, this volume presents a practical methodology for developing an effective protection system that can either prevent undesired events or mitigate the consequences of such events. Developed at Sandia National Labs, the authors analytical approach and methodology enables decision-makers and security experts to perform and utilize risk assessments in a manner that extends beyond the theoretical to practical application. These protocols leverage expertise in modeling dependencies optimizing system resiliency for effective physical protection system design and consequence mitigation.
translatedDescription: Con énfasis en la protección de la capacidad de una infraestructura para realizar su misión o función, este volumen presenta una metodología práctica para desarrollar un sistema de protección eficaz que pueda prevenir eventos no deseados o mitigar las consecuencias de tales eventos. Desarrollado en los Laboratorios Nacionales de Sandia, el enfoque analítico y la metodología de los autores permite a los responsables de la adopción de decisiones y expertos en seguridad realizar y utilizar evaluaciones de riesgos de manera que se extienda más allá de la aplicación teórica a práctica. Estos protocolos aprovechan la experiencia en la modelación de dependencias optimizando la resiliencia del sistema para el diseño eficaz del sistema de protección física y la mitigación de las consecuencias.

title: Integrated Security Systems Design
description: Integrated Security Systems Design is a one-stop resource for security directors, consultants, engineers and installation managers who are interested in providing enterprise-class security in goverment and corporate installations worldwide. An integrated security system is a system that has been incorporated into other programs (such as Access Control, Private Branch Exchanges, Human Relations, Security Video, and Intercommunications) to perform tasks in a manner consistent with corporate or agency policies and procedures. This book explains how to accomplish such integration, thereby saving a company both time and money.Integrated Security Systems Design is arranged to go from the strategic to the technical to the tactical. The strategic section covers the why of design, the technical section explains how it’s done, and the tactical section provides the cultural knowledge that leads to project success. Norman also offers guidance in avoiding pitfalls out of which lawsuits have arisen. Many of the subjects covered, such as how to make a security system invisible on an Information Technology System network, include material not available in any other book.* Centralize monitoring of security, of business processes and of adherence to policy* Learn the what-not-to-do's of security design from an experienced practitioner* Maximize your organization's safety while reducing liability and operating costs
translatedDescription: Integrated Security Systems Design es un recurso único para directores de seguridad, consultores, ingenieros y gerentes de instalación que están interesados en proporcionar seguridad de clase empresarial en instalaciones de gobierno e instalaciones corporativas en todo el mundo. Un sistema integrado de seguridad es un sistema que se ha incorporado a otros programas (como Access Control, Private Branch Exchanges, Human Relations, Security Video, and Intercommunications) para realizar tareas de manera compatible con políticas y procedimientos corporativos o de agencia. Este libro explica cómo lograr tal integración, ahorrando así tiempo y dinero a una empresa. El diseño integrado de sistemas de seguridad se organiza para pasar de lo estratégico a lo técnico a lo táctico. La sección estratégica cubre el porqué del diseño, la sección técnica explica cómo se hace, y la sección táctica proporciona el conocimiento cultural que conduce al éxito del proyecto. Norman también ofrece orientación para evitar las penurias de las que han surgido demandas. Muchos de los temas tratados, como cómo hacer invisible un sistema de seguridad en una red del Sistema de Tecnología de la Información, incluyen material que no está disponible en ningún otro libro.* Centralizar la vigilancia de la seguridad, los procesos institucionales y la adhesión a la política* Aprende el diseño de seguridad de un profesional experimentado* Maximice la seguridad de su organización al reducir los costos de responsabilidad y operación

title: BackTrack 4: Assuring Security by Penetration Testing
description:
BackTrack 4: Assuring Security by Penetration Testing is a comprehensive guide to mastering penetration testing using the BackTrack Linux distribution. You'll learn the skills and techniques needed to identify, detect, and exploit vulnerabilities, applying robust penetration testing methods in real-world scenarios.

What this Book will help me do

Configure and use BackTrack OS in your penetration testing lab effectively.
Understand and apply a structured methodology for conducting penetration tests.
Utilize a variety of security tools grouped by their specific purposes such as reconnaissance and exploitation.
Analyze and address vulnerabilities with a methodical approach to ensure accuracy.
Document and present findings with clear and professional penetration testing reports.

Author(s)

The authors of this book are experienced security professionals with extensive hands-on expertise in penetration testing and network security. Their practical knowledge of both offensive and defensive security paradigms enriches this book. They aim to help readers develop real-world skills through their instructional and methodical approach.

Who is it for?

This book is intended for IT security professionals, network administrators, and anyone with basic Unix/Linux knowledge and an interest in penetration testing using BackTrack. If you aim to improve your security testing capabilities or wish to understand network vulnerabilities and how to address them, this book is suitable for you.

Su objetivo es ayudar a los lectores a desarrollar habilidades reales a través de su enfoque instructivo y metódico.

Este libro está destinado a profesionales de seguridad de TI, administradores de red y cualquier persona con conocimientos básicos Unix/Linux y un interés en las pruebas de penetración utilizando BackTrack. Si usted busca mejorar sus capacidades de prueba de seguridad o desea entender vulnerabilidades de red y cómo abordarlas, este libro es adecuado para usted.

title: Playbook for Success: A Hall of Famer's Business Tactics for Teamwork and Leadership
description:
A top coach teaches the sports-related skills and basics every women needs to succeed

In Playbook for Success, Hall of Fame Business Entrepreneur Nancy Lieberman brings her leadership and coaching ability to the boardroom to teach professional women the same rules of success she teaches her players.

Playbook for Success is a plan to help make success a part of one's daily routine and teach women that success is not just a title or corner office, but an attitude, belief, and way of life.

Teaches the top sports-related skills women need to thrive in the corporate world, featuring a provocative examination of women and teamwork

Includes profiles of women succeeding in business, ways to recognize your own strengths and weaknesses, and exercises that can be used in the business world

Foreword by Basketball Hall of Famer and business legend Earvin "Magic" Johnson

Playbook for Success gives you a unique and inspirational road map to compete and win in your life and career.

title: Modeling and Verification Using UML Statecharts
description:
As systems being developed by industry and government grow larger and more complex, the need for superior specification and verification approaches and tools becomes increasingly vital. The developer and customer must have complete confidence that the design produced is correct, and that it meets forma development and verification standards. In this text, UML expert author Dr. Doron Drusinsky compiles all the latest information on the application of UML (Universal Modeling Language) statecharts, temporal logic, automata, and other advanced tools for run-time monitoring and verification. This is the first book that deals specifically with UML verification techniques. This important information is introduced within the context of real-life examples and solutions, particularly focusing on national defense applications. A practical text, as opposed to a high-level theoretical one, it emphasizes getting the system developer up-to-speed on using the tools necessary for daily practice.
A practical, tutorial-style text (other books on this topic discuss the tools and formalisms only theoretically)
Includes an unclassified case study example from the U.S. Missile Defense project

El desarrollador y el cliente deben tener total confianza en que el diseño producido es correcto, y que cumple con los estándares de desarrollo y verificación de forma. En este texto, el autor experto de UML, el Dr. Doron Drusinsky, recopila toda la información más reciente sobre la aplicación de estadillas UML (Universal Modeling Language), lógica temporal, automata y otras herramientas avanzadas para el monitoreo y verificación del tiempo de ejecución. Este es el primer libro que trata específicamente las técnicas de verificación UML. Esta información importante se presenta en el contexto de ejemplos y soluciones de la vida real, especialmente centradas en las aplicaciones nacionales de defensa. Un texto práctico, a diferencia de un teórico de alto nivel, hace hincapié en conseguir que el desarrollador del sistema sea actualizado a velocidad utilizando las herramientas necesarias para la práctica diaria.
Un texto práctico de estilo tutorial (otros libros sobre este tema hablan de las herramientas y formalismos sólo teóricamente)
Incluye un ejemplo de estudio de caso no clasificado del proyecto U.S. Missile Defense

title: The Cybersecurity Playbook
description:
The real-world guide to defeating hackers and keeping your business secure

Many books discuss the technical underpinnings and complex configurations necessary for cybersecurity—but they fail to address the everyday steps that boards, managers, and employees can take to prevent attacks. The Cybersecurity Playbook is the step-by-step guide to protecting your organization from unknown threats and integrating good security habits into everyday business situations. This book provides clear guidance on how to identify weaknesses, assess possible threats, and implement effective policies. Recognizing that an organization’s security is only as strong as its weakest link, this book offers specific strategies for employees at every level.

Drawing from her experience as CMO of one of the world’s largest cybersecurity companies, author Allison Cerra incorporates straightforward assessments, adaptable action plans, and many current examples to provide practical recommendations for cybersecurity policies. By demystifying cybersecurity and applying the central concepts to real-world business scenarios, this book will help you:

Deploy cybersecurity measures using easy-to-follow methods and proven techniques
Develop a practical security plan tailor-made for your specific needs
Incorporate vital security practices into your everyday workflow quickly and efficiently

The ever-increasing connectivity of modern organizations, and their heavy use of cloud-based solutions present unique challenges: data breaches, malicious software infections, and cyberattacks have become commonplace and costly to organizations worldwide. The Cybersecurity Playbook is the invaluable guide to identifying security gaps, getting buy-in from the top, promoting effective daily security routines, and safeguarding vital resources. Strong cybersecurity is no longer the sole responsibility of IT departments, but that of every executive, manager, and employee.
translatedDescription:
La guía del mundo real para derrotar a los hackers y mantener su negocio seguro

Muchos libros hablan de los fundamentos técnicos y las complejas configuraciones necesarias para la ciberseguridad, pero no abordan los pasos cotidianos que pueden tomar las juntas, gerentes y empleados para prevenir ataques. El Cybersecurity Playbook es la guía paso a paso para proteger a su organización de amenazas desconocidas e integrar buenos hábitos de seguridad en situaciones de negocios cotidianas. Este libro proporciona una orientación clara sobre cómo identificar las deficiencias, evaluar las posibles amenazas y aplicar políticas eficaces. Reconociendo que la seguridad de una organización es tan fuerte como su vínculo más débil, este libro ofrece estrategias específicas para los empleados a cada nivel.

Basándose en su experiencia como CMO de una de las mayores empresas de ciberseguridad del mundo, la autora Allison Cerra incorpora evaluaciones directas, planes de acción adaptables y muchos ejemplos actuales para proporcionar recomendaciones prácticas para las políticas de ciberseguridad. Al desmitificar la ciberseguridad y aplicar los conceptos centrales a los escenarios de negocios del mundo real, este libro te ayudará:

Implementar medidas de ciberseguridad utilizando métodos fáciles de seguir y técnicas probadas
Desarrollar un plan de seguridad práctico a medida para sus necesidades específicas
Incorporar prácticas de seguridad vital en su flujo de trabajo cotidiano de forma rápida y eficiente

La conectividad cada vez mayor de las organizaciones modernas y su uso intensivo de soluciones basadas en la nube presentan desafíos únicos: brechas de datos, infecciones maliciosas de software y ciberataques se han convertido en un lugar común y costoso para las organizaciones de todo el mundo. El Cybersecurity Playbook es la guía invaluable para identificar las brechas de seguridad, obtener el buy-in de la parte superior, promover rutinas de seguridad diaria eficaces y salvaguardar los recursos vitales. La fuerte ciberseguridad ya no es la única responsabilidad de los departamentos de TI, sino la de cada ejecutivo, gerente y empleado.

title: Say Anything to Anyone, Anywhere: 5 Keys To Successful Cross-Cultural Communication
description:
The five steps to successful selling, negotiating, and managing multi-culturally

Say Anything to Anyone, Anywhere gives readers five simple key guidelines to create rapport and organize strategies for success across different cultures. This book teaches to be proactive, not reactive, in your cross-cultural communications and shows how to use simple rapport tools to create trust with the cultures you work with or travel to. Learn how to organize productive interactions in person, on the phone, and by email. Discover interpersonal communication skills and virtual strategies that build strong relationships.

Offers quick, accessible examples and clear guidelines about how to create an understanding between cultures

Gives tips and strategies on how to communicate without offending

Author Gayle Cotton is a Emmy Award Winner and a distinguished, highly sought after speaker, corporate trainer, and executive coach.

This step-by-step guide to cross-cultural business will help you build strong relationships and manage successfully, no matter the cultural differences.

Este libro enseña a ser proactivo, no reactiva, en sus comunicaciones interculturales y muestra cómo utilizar herramientas de rapport simples para crear confianza con las culturas con las que trabajas o viajas. Aprende a organizar interacciones productivas en persona, por teléfono y por correo electrónico. Descubra habilidades de comunicación interpersonal y estrategias virtuales que construyen relaciones fuertes.

Ofrece ejemplos rápidos y accesibles y directrices claras sobre cómo crear un entendimiento entre culturas

Da consejos y estrategias sobre cómo comunicarse sin ofender

Autor Gayle Cotton es un ganador del premio Emmy y un distinguido, altamente buscado orador, entrenador corporativo y entrenador ejecutivo.

Esta guía paso a paso para el negocio intercultural le ayudará a construir relaciones fuertes y gestionar con éxito, sin importar las diferencias culturales.

title: Penetration Testing Fundamentals: A Hands-On Guide to Reliable Security Audits

The perfect introduction to pen testing for all IT professionals and students

· Clearly explains key concepts, terminology, challenges, tools, and skills

· Covers the latest penetration testing standards from NSA, PCI, and NIST

Welcome to today’s most useful and practical introduction to penetration testing. Chuck Easttom brings together up-to-the-minute coverage of all the concepts, terminology, challenges, and skills you’ll need to be effective.

Drawing on decades of experience in cybersecurity and related IT fields, Easttom integrates theory and practice, covering the entire penetration testing life cycle from planning to reporting.

You’ll gain practical experience through a start-to-finish sample project relying on free open source tools. Throughout, quizzes, projects, and review sections deepen your understanding and help you apply what you’ve learned.

Including essential pen testing standards from NSA, PCI, and NIST, Penetration Testing Fundamentals will help you protect your assets–and expand your career options.

· Meet modern standards for comprehensive and effective testing

· Scan for vulnerabilities with OWASP ZAP, Vega, Nessus, and MBSA

· Identify Linux vulnerabilities and password cracks

· Use Kali Linux for advanced pen testing

· Apply general hacking technique ssuch as fake Wi-Fi hotspots and social engineering

· Write or customize sophisticated Metasploit exploits

title: Building Virtual Pentesting Labs for Advanced Penetration Testing - Second Edition
description:
Master the art of penetration testing and virtual lab building with 'Building Virtual Pentesting Labs for Advanced Penetration Testing'. This hands-on guide is your path to developing advanced security skills by constructing complex testing environments to emulate enterprise networks and fortified setups.

What this Book will help me do

Create complex virtual lab environments for network and system security testing.
Master penetration testing methodologies and tools through practical exercises.
Understand enterprise defense mechanisms and learn methods to bypass them.
Enhance your problem-solving skills by tackling advanced cybersecurity challenges.
Gain proficiency in constructing and attacking layered architectures for training purposes.

Author(s)

None Cardwell is a seasoned professional in cybersecurity with years of experience in penetration testing and security architecture. Their expertise in simulating realistic security scenarios has helped numerous security professionals elevate their skills. With a passion for teaching, None aims to make advanced cybersecurity concepts accessible and applicable.

Who is it for?

This book is suited for cybersecurity professionals and penetration testers seeking to build custom virtual labs. Ideal readers include those with a solid understanding of networks and security concepts looking to enhance their practical skills. Beginners can also benefit provided they have foundational knowledge. If you aim to advance your security testing expertise in a systematic manner, this is for you.

Domine el arte de las pruebas de penetración y el edificio de laboratorio virtual con 'Building Virtual Pentesting Labs for Advanced Penetration Testing'. Esta guía práctica es su camino para desarrollar habilidades avanzadas de seguridad mediante la construcción de entornos complejos de prueba para emular redes empresariales y configuraciones fortificadas.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Cree entornos complejos de laboratorio virtual para pruebas de seguridad de redes y sistemas.
Metodologías y herramientas de pruebas de penetración maestras a través de ejercicios prácticos.
Comprender los mecanismos de defensa empresarial y aprender métodos para evitarlos.
Mejora tus habilidades de solución de problemas abordando retos avanzados de seguridad cibernética.
Obtenga competencia en la construcción y ataque de arquitecturas capas con fines de capacitación.

Autor(s)

Ninguno Cardwell es un profesional experimentado en ciberseguridad con años de experiencia en pruebas de penetración y arquitectura de seguridad. Su experiencia en simular escenarios de seguridad realistas ha ayudado a numerosos profesionales de la seguridad a elevar sus habilidades. Con pasión por la enseñanza, Ninguno pretende hacer accesibles y aplicables conceptos avanzados de ciberseguridad.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es adecuado para profesionales de la ciberseguridad y testers de penetración que buscan construir laboratorios virtuales personalizados. Los lectores ideales incluyen aquellos con una comprensión sólida de las redes y conceptos de seguridad que buscan mejorar sus habilidades prácticas. Los principiantes también pueden beneficiarse siempre que tengan conocimiento fundacional. Si usted pretende avanzar su experiencia en pruebas de seguridad de manera sistemática, esto es para usted.

title: Talk Less, Say More: Three Habits to Influence Others and Make Things Happen
description:
Talk Less, Say More is a revolutionary guide to 21st century communication skills to help you be more influential and make things happen in our distracted, attention-deficit world. It's loaded with specific tips and takeaways to ensure that you're fully heard, clearly understood, and trigger positive responses in any business or social situation.

It's the first book to deliver a proven method to master the core leadership skill of influence. Talk Less, Say More lays out a powerful 3-step method called Connect, Convey, Convince (R) and guides you in how to use these habits to be more influential. This succinct book solves your modern communication issues in today's demanding, distracted world at a time when interaction skills are plummeting.

Communication is the single greatest challenge in business today. It takes just 3 habits to conquer it. Talk Less, Say More will help you achieve more with less. Less wordiness. Less tune-out. Less frustration. You'll gain more time. More positive outcomes. More rewarding relationships.
translatedDescription:
Talk Less, Say More es una guía revolucionaria de las habilidades de comunicación del siglo XXI para ayudarte a ser más influyente y hacer que las cosas sucedan en nuestro mundo distraído y deficiente de atención. Está cargado de consejos específicos y de tomas para asegurarse de que usted está completamente oído, entendido claramente, y desencadenar respuestas positivas en cualquier situación empresarial o social.

Es el primer libro que ofrece un método probado para dominar la habilidad de liderazgo central de influencia. Talk Less, Say More establece un poderoso método de 3 pasos llamado Connect, Convey, Convince (R) y le guía en cómo utilizar estos hábitos para ser más influyente. Este libro sucinto resuelve tus problemas de comunicación modernos en el mundo exigente y distraído de hoy en un momento en que las habilidades de interacción se desploman.

La comunicación es el mayor reto en el negocio de hoy. Se necesitan solo 3 hábitos para conquistarlo. Talk Less, Say More te ayudará a lograr más con menos. Menos calumnia. Menos sintonía. Menos frustración. Ganarás más tiempo. Resultados más positivos. Relaciones más gratificantes.

title: Web Security and Commerce
description:
Attacks on government Web sites, break-ins at Internet service providers, electronic credit card fraud, invasion of personal privacy by merchants as well as hackers--is this what the World Wide Web is really all about? Web Security & Commerce cuts through the hype and the front page stories. It tells you what the real risks are and explains how you can minimize them. Whether you're a casual (but concerned) Web surfer or a system administrator responsible for the security of a critical Web server, this book will tell you what you need to know. Entertaining as well as illuminating, it looks behind the headlines at the technologies, risks, and benefits of the Web. Whatever browser or server you are using, you and your system will benefit from this book. Topics include:

User safety--browser vulnerabilities (with an emphasis on Netscape Navigator and Microsoft Internet Explorer), privacy concerns, issues with Java, JavaScript, ActiveX, and plug-ins.

Digital certificates--what they are, how they assure identity in a networked environment, how certification authorities and server certificates work, and what code signing all about.

Cryptography--an overview of how encryption works on the Internet and how different algorithms and programs are being used today.

Web server security--detailed technical information about SSL (Secure Socket Layer), TLS (Transport Layer Security), host security, server access methods, and secure CGI/API programming.

Commerce and society--how digital payments work, what blocking software and censorship technology (e.g., PICS and RSACi) is about, and what civil and criminal issues you need to understand.
translatedDescription:
Ataques en sitios web gubernamentales, allanamientos en proveedores de servicios de Internet, fraude electrónico de tarjetas de crédito, invasión de la privacidad personal por los comerciantes, así como hackers, ¿es esto de lo que la World Wide Web es realmente todo? Seguridad Web & Commerce corta el himpe y las historias de primera página. Te dice cuáles son los riesgos reales y explica cómo puedes minimizarlos. Ya sea casual (pero preocupado) Web surfer o un administrador del sistema responsable de la seguridad de un servidor Web crítico, este libro le dirá lo que necesita saber. Entrando así como iluminando, mira detrás de los titulares de las tecnologías, riesgos y beneficios de la Web. Cualquier navegador o servidor que esté usando, usted y su sistema se beneficiarán de este libro. Los temas incluyen:

Seguridad del usuario: vulnerabilidades del navegador (con énfasis en Netscape Navigator y Microsoft Internet Explorer), problemas de privacidad, problemas con Java, JavaScript, ActiveX y plug-ins.

Certificados digitales - lo que son, cómo aseguran la identidad en un entorno en red, cómo funcionan las autoridades de certificación y certificados de servidor, y qué código de firma de todo.

Criptografía--una visión general de cómo funciona la encriptación en Internet y cómo se utilizan diferentes algoritmos y programas hoy en día.

Seguridad del servidor web - información técnica detallada sobre SSL (Secure Socket Layer), TLS (Transport Layer Security), seguridad del host, métodos de acceso al servidor y programación segura CGI/API.

Comercio y sociedad - cómo funcionan los pagos digitales, qué bloqueo de software y tecnología de censura (p. ej., PICS y RSACi) se trata, y qué asuntos civiles y penales necesitas entender.

title: Advanced Persistent Security
description:
Advanced Persistent Security covers secure network design and implementation, including authentication, authorization, data and access integrity, network monitoring, and risk assessment. Using such recent high profile cases as Target, Sony, and Home Depot, the book explores information security risks, identifies the common threats organizations face, and presents tactics on how to prioritize the right countermeasures.

The book discusses concepts such as malignant versus malicious threats, adversary mentality, motivation, the economics of cybercrime, the criminal infrastructure, dark webs, and the criminals organizations currently face.

Contains practical and cost-effective recommendations for proactive and reactive protective measures
Teaches users how to establish a viable threat intelligence program
Focuses on how social networks present a double-edged sword against security programs
translatedDescription:
La Seguridad Persistente Avanzada cubre el diseño e implementación de redes seguras, incluyendo autenticación, autorización, datos e integridad de acceso, monitoreo de red y evaluación de riesgos. Utilizando casos tan recientes de alto perfil como Target, Sony y Home Depot, el libro explora los riesgos de seguridad de la información, identifica a las organizaciones de amenazas comunes enfrentadas, y presenta tácticas sobre cómo priorizar las contramedidas correctas.

El libro analiza conceptos como amenazas malignas contra malintencionadas, mentalidad adversaria, motivación, la economía del cibercrimen, la infraestructura criminal, webs oscuras y las organizaciones de delincuentes que se enfrentan actualmente.

Contiene recomendaciones prácticas y eficaces en función de los costos para medidas de protección proactivas y reactivas
Teaches users how to establish a viable threat intelligence program
Se centra en cómo las redes sociales presentan una espada de doble filo contra los programas de seguridad

title: Computer Security: Protecting Digital Resources
description:
Today, society is faced with numerous internet schemes, fraudulent scams, and means of identity theft that threaten our safety and our peace of mind. Computer Security: Protecting Digital Resources provides a broad approach to computer-related crime, electronic commerce, corporate networking, and Internet security, topics that have become increasingly important as more and more threats are made on our internet environment. This book is oriented toward the average computer user, business professional, government worker, and those within the education community, with the expectation that readers can learn to use the network with some degree of safety and security. The author places emphasis on the numerous vulnerabilities and threats that are inherent in the Internet environment. Efforts are made to present techniques and suggestions to avoid identity theft and fraud.

Readers will gain a clear insight into the many security issues facing the e-commerce, networking, web, and internet environments, as well as what can be done to keep personal and business information secure.
translatedDescription:
Hoy en día, la sociedad se enfrenta a numerosos esquemas de Internet, estafas fraudulentas y medios de robo de identidad que amenazan nuestra seguridad y nuestra paz mental. Seguridad informática: La protección de los recursos digitales proporciona un enfoque amplio de los delitos informáticos, el comercio electrónico, las redes corporativas y la seguridad de Internet, temas que se han vuelto cada vez más importantes a medida que se hacen más amenazas en nuestro entorno de Internet. Este libro está orientado hacia el usuario promedio de ordenadores, profesionales de negocios, trabajadores gubernamentales, y aquellos dentro de la comunidad educativa, con la expectativa de que los lectores puedan aprender a utilizar la red con cierto grado de seguridad. El autor pone énfasis en las numerosas vulnerabilidades y amenazas inherentes al entorno de Internet. Se realizan esfuerzos para presentar técnicas y sugerencias para evitar el robo de identidad y el fraude.

Los lectores obtendrán una visión clara de los muchos problemas de seguridad que enfrenta el comercio electrónico, las redes, la web y los entornos de Internet, así como lo que se puede hacer para mantener la información personal y empresarial segura.

title: How Cyber Security Can Protect Your Business - A guide for all stakeholders
description: How Cyber Security Can Protect your Business – A guide for all stakeholders provides an effective and efficient framework for managing cyber governance, risk and compliance, which organisations can adapt to meet their own risk appetite and synchronise with their people, processes and technology.
translatedDescription: Cómo la Seguridad Cibernética puede proteger su negocio – Una guía para todas las partes interesadas proporciona un marco eficaz y eficiente para gestionar la gobernanza cibernética, el riesgo y el cumplimiento, que las organizaciones pueden adaptarse para satisfacer su propio apetito de riesgo y sincronizar con su gente, procesos y tecnología.

title: Beginning Serverless Architectures with Microsoft Azure
description:
This book introduces you to serverless development using Microsoft Azure, guiding you through the creation and management of serverless architectures with real-world applications. You'll start from fundamental concepts and progress towards building and deploying scalable, efficient microservices that integrate seamlessly with other Azure offerings like Azure Functions, App Insights, and Cosmos DB.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the advantages of serverless architecture for modern application development.
Design and implement scalable and efficient serverless services using Microsoft Azure.
Master Azure Functions to create and manage serverless operations.
Integrate Azure services like Cosmos DB and App Insights into your projects.
Acquire the skills to plan, deploy, and maintain serverless applications.

Author(s)

Daniel Bass is an experienced software architect and developer specializing in serverless technologies. With a passion for simplifying complex concepts, he has authored multiple projects and tutorials on distributed systems and cloud computing. Daniel combines real-world experience with a developer-first perspective to provide pragmatic and actionable insights into the world of serverless architectures.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for backend developers, software engineers, and IT professionals seeking a practical and focused introduction to serverless architectures using Microsoft Azure. If you're already familiar with cloud computing concepts and are eager to implement serverless solutions, this book is tailored for you. Its structured exercises offer hands-on learning, making it suitable for advancing your career. Whether you're transitioning from traditional to modern application models or exploring Azure specialties, this book will guide you.
translatedDescription:
Este libro le presenta al desarrollo sin servidor usando Microsoft Azure, guiándole a través de la creación y gestión de arquitecturas sin servidor con aplicaciones reales. Comenzarás desde conceptos fundamentales y avanzarás hacia la construcción e implementación de microservicios escalables y eficientes que se integran perfectamente con otras ofertas Azure como Funciones Azure, Insights App y Cosmos DB.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprenda las ventajas de la arquitectura sin servidor para el desarrollo moderno de aplicaciones.
Diseñar e implementar servicios escalables y eficientes sin servidor utilizando Microsoft Azure.
Funciones Master Azure para crear y gestionar operaciones sin servidor.
Integrar los servicios de Azure como Cosmos DB y App Insights en tus proyectos.
Adquirir las habilidades para planificar, desplegar y mantener aplicaciones sin servidor.

Autor(s)

Daniel Bass es un experimentado arquitecto de software y desarrollador especializado en tecnologías sin servidor. Con pasión por simplificar conceptos complejos, ha autorizado múltiples proyectos y tutoriales sobre sistemas distribuidos y computación en la nube. Daniel combina experiencia en el mundo real con una perspectiva de desarrollo para proporcionar ideas pragmáticas y factibles en el mundo de arquitecturas sin servidor.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores de backend, ingenieros de software y profesionales de TI que buscan una introducción práctica y enfocada a arquitecturas sin servidor utilizando Microsoft Azure. Si ya estás familiarizado con conceptos de computación en la nube y estás ansioso por implementar soluciones sin servidor, este libro está adaptado para ti. Sus ejercicios estructurados ofrecen aprendizaje práctico, lo que lo hace adecuado para avanzar su carrera. Ya sea que esté pasando de modelos de aplicación tradicionales a modernos o explorando especialidades de Azure, este libro le guiará.

title: Halt Impostor Syndrome Before It Happens
description: Impostor syndrome can make employees question their intelligence, competence, and sense of belonging. But workers who don’t speak up in meetings or apply for promotions might actually be feeling the effects of impostorization — workplace policies, practices, and interactions that make individuals question their intelligence, competence, and sense of belonging. The author shares examples of the phenomenon, along with tips to help managers avoid triggering impostor syndrome among employees.
translatedDescription: El síndrome de Impostor puede hacer que los empleados cuestionen su inteligencia, competencia y sentido de pertenencia. Pero los trabajadores que no hablan en reuniones o solicitan promociones podrían sentir realmente los efectos de la impostorización: políticas, prácticas e interacciones en el lugar de trabajo que hacen que las personas cuestionen su inteligencia, competencia y sentido de pertenencia. El autor comparte ejemplos del fenómeno, junto con consejos para ayudar a los administradores a evitar desencadenar el síndrome de impostor entre los empleados.

title: The Rules of People
description: A PERSONAL CODE FOR GETTING THE BEST FROM EVERYONE. We all know someone who is a natural ‘people person’. They seem to understand what people really want, what they really think and what they really mean. They can effortlessly get people onside, and keep them happy and motivated. Is there something they know that the rest of us don't? Is it something we can all learn? The answer is a resounding yes. They know The Rules of People. These Rules are the guiding principles that show you how to connect with strangers, build strong relationships with friends and colleagues, and even get the best out of difficult people. They will help you say the right thing, do the right thing, and know instinctively how to handle every situation. You’ll have relaxed, easy relationships and you’ll be that person who gets on with everyone.
translatedDescription: Un código personal para conseguir lo mejor de todos. Todos conocemos a alguien que es una persona natural. Parecen entender lo que la gente realmente quiere, lo que realmente piensan y lo que realmente significan. Ellos pueden conseguir sin esfuerzo a la gente, y mantenerlos felices y motivados. ¿Hay algo que saben que el resto de nosotros no? ¿Es algo que todos podemos aprender? La respuesta es un sí resonante. Conocen las reglas de la gente. Estas Reglas son los principios rectores que le muestran cómo conectarse con extraños, construir fuertes relaciones con amigos y colegas, e incluso obtener lo mejor de las personas difíciles. Ellos te ayudarán a decir lo correcto, hacer lo correcto, y saber instintivamente cómo manejar cada situación. Usted tendrá relaciones relajadas, fáciles y usted será esa persona que se pone con todos.

title: How Personal & Internet Security Work
description:
In 2003, fraud and identity theft cost consumers at least $437 million dollars. In 2004, the U.S. Federal Trade Commission received 247,000 consumer complaints in 2004 (up 15% from 2003), from individuals whose identity was stolen, and according to Reuters.com (2/2005), Americans lost $548 million dollars to identity theft and consumer fraud in 2004. Don't allow yourself to become a part of the statistics!

How Personal and Internet Security Works illustrates in vivid detail the many dangers faced by those who use the Internet to send or receive email, surf the Web, conduct personal business, use a credit card, or even travel to airports and how those dangers can be solved. You'll also get detailed explanations of Internet privacy issues such as spyware, phishing, identity theft, data mining, biometrics, and security cameras, as well as Homeland Security issues such as airport scanning and terrorist screening.
translatedDescription:
En 2003, el fraude y el robo de identidad cuestan a los consumidores al menos 437 millones de dólares. En 2004, la Comisión Federal de Comercio de los Estados Unidos recibió 247.000 denuncias de consumidores en 2004 (hasta un 15% de 2003), de personas cuya identidad fue robada, y según Reuters.com (2/2005), los estadounidenses perdieron $548 millones de dólares para robo de identidad y fraude al consumidor en 2004. ¡No te permitas formar parte de las estadísticas!

Cómo Funciona la Seguridad Personal e Internet ilustra en detalle los muchos peligros que enfrentan aquellos que utilizan Internet para enviar o recibir correo electrónico, navegar por la Web, realizar negocios personales, utilizar una tarjeta de crédito, o incluso viajar a aeropuertos y cómo se pueden resolver esos peligros. También obtendrá explicaciones detalladas de problemas de privacidad de Internet, como spyware, phishing, identitario, minería de datos, biometría y cámaras de seguridad, así como problemas de Seguridad Nacional, como el escaneo del aeropuerto y la detección terrorista.

title: Writing for the Workplace
description: Employers consider communication one of the most critical skills for workers today. Writing for the Workplace: Business Communication for Professionals is an easy- to-follow guide that provides strategies for effective professional communication. Written to address the needs of both students entering the workforce and business professionals looking to improve their written communication, the book offers guides to compose typical workplace documents, from effective e-mails and convincing reports to winning presentations and engaging resumes. This concise book offers busy readers concrete strategies to improve their workplace writing.
translatedDescription: Los empleadores consideran la comunicación una de las habilidades más críticas para los trabajadores de hoy. Escribir para el lugar de trabajo: Comunicación empresarial para profesionales es una guía fácil de seguir que proporciona estrategias para una comunicación profesional eficaz. Escrito para atender las necesidades de ambos estudiantes que entran en la fuerza laboral y profesionales de negocios que buscan mejorar su comunicación escrita, el libro ofrece guías para componer documentos típicos del lugar de trabajo, desde correos electrónicos eficaces y informes convincentes para ganar presentaciones y curriculum vitae. Este libro conciso ofrece a los lectores ocupados estrategias concretas para mejorar su escritura laboral.

title: Developing Serverless Applications
description:
Serverless computing has become a compelling option for many developers, evidenced by the many serverless platforms now available. Also known as Function as a Service, serverless computing lets developers deploy applications to the cloud without having to provision or manage a server—or pay for a server when it’s not in use. You simply deploy the logic that comprises your application, while your cloud-based serverless provider handles everything else.

With this practical report, author Raymond Camden shows you how to develop serverless code with Apache OpenWhisk, an open source serverless platform. You’ll also get an introduction to OpenWhisk with Bluemix, a feature of IBM’s cloud platform as a service suite. IBM, a major OpenWhisk supporter along with Adobe and Red Hat, provides an optional, easy-to-use way to deploy and host your OpenWhisk code.

Get guidelines and rules for building and using actions, OpenWhisk’s version of functions
Use actions in production with OpenWhisk’s Web Actions, the Bluemix API Management feature, or a REST API
Combine actions into sequences, enabling several actions to work together in a single function
Create, manage, and share packages for organizing your OpenWhisk actions
translatedDescription:
El cálculo sin servidor se ha convertido en una opción convincente para muchos desarrolladores, evidenciada por las muchas plataformas sin servidor ahora disponibles. También conocido como Función como Servicio, el cálculo sin servidor permite a los desarrolladores desplegar aplicaciones en la nube sin tener que proporcionar o administrar un servidor, o pagar por un servidor cuando no está en uso. Simplemente implementa la lógica que comprende su aplicación, mientras que su proveedor sin servidor basado en la nube maneja todo lo demás.

Con este informe práctico, el autor Raymond Camden le muestra cómo desarrollar código sin servidor con Apache OpenWhisk, una plataforma sin servidor de código abierto. También obtendrá una introducción a OpenWhisk con Bluemix, una característica de la plataforma de nube de IBM como suite de servicio. IBM, un importante partidario de OpenWhisk junto con Adobe y Red Hat, proporciona una manera opcional y fácil de usar para desplegar y acoger su código OpenWhisk.

Obtenga directrices y reglas para construir y utilizar acciones, versión de OpenWhisk de funciones
Utilice acciones en producción con OpenWhisk Web Actions, la función Bluemix API Management o una API REST
Combine acciones en secuencias, permitiendo que varias acciones trabajen juntas en una sola función
Crear, gestionar y compartir paquetes para organizar tus acciones OpenWhisk

title: Radically Collaborative Patterns for Software Makers
description:
Get a unique collection of radically collaborative patterns for building software with others. In this mini-encyclopedia, third-generation programmer Matthew Parker introduces you to 27 successful patterns used in organizations that follow distinctive methodologies such as Scrum, Extreme Programming, SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), and others.

Each short essay in this report describes why a particular pattern is useful and helps you understand just how radical each one really is. Because the patterns in this guide are differentiated but integrated, none of them can be described without referring to others. Rather than read this book from cover to cover, choose patterns that stand out for you and move around the chapters from there.

You’ll explore:

High-level patterns: Autonomy of Space, Collocation, Communal Breakfast, Free Snacks, Outsider-In, Play Space, and Workspace Standup
Team-wide patterns: Balanced Team, Collaborative Story Acceptance, Discovery and Framing, Facilitation, Information Radiator, Team Standup, User Stories, Velocity, and more
Patterns specific to specialized roles: Continuous Integration/Continuous, Deployment, Pair Programming, Promiscuous Pairing, Test-Driven Development, and more
translatedDescription:
Obtenga una colección única de patrones radicalmente colaborativos para construir software con otros. En esta mini-encyclopedia, el programador de tercera generación Matthew Parker le presenta a 27 patrones exitosos utilizados en organizaciones que siguen metodologías distintivas como Scrum, Extreme Programming, SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), y otros.

Cada ensayo corto en este informe describe por qué un patrón particular es útil y le ayuda a entender lo radical que es cada uno realmente. Debido a que los patrones en esta guía son diferenciados pero integrados, ninguno de ellos se puede describir sin referirse a otros. En lugar de leer este libro de portada para cubrir, elegir patrones que destacan por usted y moverse alrededor de los capítulos de allí.

Explorarás:

Patrones de alto nivel: Autonomía del Espacio, Collocación, Desayuno Comunitario, Snacks Libres, Extranjero-In, Espacio de Juego y Standup Workspace
Patrones en todo el equipo: Equipo equilibrado, Aceptación colaborativa de historias, descubrimiento y definición, facilitación, radiador de información, equipo de soporte, historias de usuario, velocidad y más
Patrones específicos para funciones especializadas: Integración continua/Continuidad, Despliegue, Programación de Parejas, Pareja promiscuosa, Desarrollo de Test-Driven, y más

title: Process Quality Assurance for UML-Based Projects
description:
Software quality, by its very nature, is elusive. Add to that the issue of ever-changing user requirements and the vagaries of software project management and "quality" can easily become a mere word on a distant horizon. This highly acclaimed book demonstrates how the Unified Modeling Language (UML) can be used within a process framework to help reduce complexity, clarify requirements, and add structure to project management in order to yield software quality here and now.

Process Quality Assurance for UML-Based Projects focuses on the crucial process aspect of software quality. In an easy, entertaining way, the author outlines common-sense strategies for determining the applicability of UML to a project, creating and managing project teams, identifying levels of quality standards, applying quality techniques, and estimating and testing in UML-based projects.

With this book you will be able to:

Understand the elusive nature of software quality, the pressures on software quality, and the importance of processes and modeling in enhancing software quality

Divide modeling into three distinct but related spaces--problem, solution, and background space--and correlate the roles of business analyst, system designer, and system architect to these modeling spaces respectively

Understand quality discussions applicable to small, medium, and large projects

Appreciate the sociological aspect of quality management in software projects, including the value of transactional analysis (TA) in team formation and motivation

Relate to an iterative and incremental process based on the concepts of process-components and related activities, tasks, roles, and deliverables

Move your organization forward in terms of CMM process maturity

Gain valuable and practical insights into process and project metrics, measurements, and estimations

Appreciate the strategic aspect of testing as it relates to quality assurance

Understand quality discussions applicable to new developments, integration, package implementation, outsourcing, data warehousing, and educational projects

Access extremely well-referenced work by leading practitioners, researchers, and academicians

Estimate and refine process and project metrics

At the end of each chapter, key points are encapsulated in FAQs and exercises for easy referencing and team training.

0201758210B08132002
translatedDescription:
La calidad del software, por su propia naturaleza, es difícil. Añadir a esto el tema de los requisitos de usuario siempre cambiantes y los vagabundos de gestión de proyectos de software y "calidad" puede convertirse fácilmente en una palabra simple en un horizonte distante. Este libro muy aclamado demuestra cómo el lenguaje de modelado unificado (UML) se puede utilizar dentro de un marco de proceso para ayudar a reducir la complejidad, aclarar los requisitos y añadir estructura a la gestión de proyectos para producir calidad de software aquí y ahora.

La garantía de calidad del proceso para los proyectos basados en UML se centra en el aspecto crucial del proceso de calidad del software. De manera fácil y entretenida, el autor describe estrategias de sentido común para determinar la aplicabilidad de la UML a un proyecto, crear y gestionar equipos de proyectos, identificar niveles de estándares de calidad, aplicar técnicas de calidad y estimar y probar en proyectos basados en UML.

Con este libro podrás:

Comprender la naturaleza elusiva de la calidad del software, las presiones sobre la calidad del software, y la importancia de los procesos y el modelado para mejorar la calidad del software

Divide modelado en tres espacios distintos pero relacionados -problema, solución y espacio de fondo - y correlaciona los roles de analista de negocios, diseñador de sistemas y arquitecto de sistemas a estos espacios de modelado respectivamente

Comprender discusiones de calidad aplicables a proyectos pequeños, medianos y grandes

Apreciar el aspecto sociológico de la gestión de la calidad en los proyectos de software, incluido el valor del análisis transaccional (TA) en la formación de equipos y la motivación

title: Multilevel Modeling of Secure Systems in QoP-ML
description: This book introduces the author's quality of protection modeling language (QoP-ML), which provides the multilevel modeling language for making abstraction of security systems that put emphasis on the details concerning quality of protection. The analysis of the secure systems can be performed automatically by means of an automated quality of protection analysis tool. Based on the multilevel analysis, the foundations of the new decision support system can be introduced. The book includes a number of examples and case studies that illustrate the QoP analysis process by the QoP-ML.

El análisis de los sistemas seguros se puede realizar automáticamente mediante una herramienta automatizada de análisis de calidad de protección. title: Greatness Is a Choice
description:
A battle-tested guide on how to live a great life

In Greatness Is a Choice, Wall Street legend Ethan Penner presents a jewel box filled with thoughts and ideas that challenge readers by stimulating a higher level of awareness and critical thinking. Penner’s forthright style makes the book invaluable to a broad range of readers. Each chapter is a guidepost for today’s challenging societal issues, but the words are also rooted in timeless thinking culled from Penner’s considerable personal and professional experiences. Greatness Is a Choice asks readers to consider new ideas and strategies as critical tools in the pursuit of a better life for themselves and their families.

Greatness Is a Choice is also a compendium of values and ideals anyone can adopt to achieve greater personal and societal fulfillment. Penner writes about kindness, respect, and faith, along with a healthy reverence for family and legacy. Penner challenges readers to see the natural interconnectivity of politics, finance, economics, ideology, faith, nature, and music. Readers will:

Discover new ways of thinking about how to define and attain personal success.
Be reminded of the American principles that contributed to the nation’s rapid ascent and still serve as a beacon of hope, equality, and prosperity.
Learn how choices to pursue a life of personal growth also benefit society.
Be challenged to think and take action to do their part in creating a more peaceful and productive future.

Greatness Is a Choice is a must-read for anyone with the courage to be intellectually challenged, consider and adopt new ideas, and think deeply about choices that lead to better lives for ourselves and our children. It is an ideal book to share with others to help establish a better intellectual framework for our future.

title: Beyond Cybersecurity: Protecting Your Digital Business
description:
Move beyond cybersecurity to take protection of your digital business to the next level

Beyond Cybersecurity: Protecting Your Digital Business arms your company against devastating online security breaches by providing you with the information and guidance you need to avoid catastrophic data compromise. Based upon highly-regarded risk assessment analysis, this critical text is founded upon proprietary research, client experience, and interviews with over 200 executives, regulators, and security experts, offering you a well-rounded, thoroughly researched resource that presents its findings in an organized, approachable style. In addition to the text, you receive access to digital materials that further reinforce key concepts, including a cybersecurity risk maturity survey, cybersecurity templates and checklists, and access to all survey results associated with cybersecurity.

Members of the global economy have spent years and tens of billions of dollars fighting cyber threats—but attacks remain an immense concern in the world of online business. The threat of data compromise that can lead to the leak of important financial and personal details can make consumers suspicious of the digital economy, and cause a nosedive in their trust and confidence in online business models.

Understand the critical issue of cyber-attacks, and how they are both a social and a business issue that could slow the pace of innovation while wreaking financial havoc

Consider how step-change capability improvements can create more resilient organizations

Discuss how increased collaboration within the cybersecurity industry could improve alignment on a broad range of policy issues

Explore how the active engagement of top-level business and public leaders can achieve progress toward cyber-resiliency

Beyond Cybersecurity: Protecting Your Digital Business is an essential resource for business leaders who want to protect their organizations against cyber-attacks.

title: Enemy at the Water Cooler
description: The book covers a decade of work with some of the largest commercial and government agencies around the world in addressing cyber security related to malicious insiders (trusted employees, contractors, and partners). It explores organized crime, terrorist threats, and hackers. It addresses the steps organizations must take to address insider threats at a people, process, and technology level. Today’s headlines are littered with news of identity thieves, organized cyber criminals, corporate espionage, nation-state threats, and terrorists. They represent the next wave of security threats but still possess nowhere near the devastating potential of the most insidious threat: the insider. This is not the bored 16-year-old hacker. We are talking about insiders like you and me, trusted employees with access to information - consultants, contractors, partners, visitors, vendors, and cleaning crews. Anyone in an organization’s building or networks that possesses some level of trust.* Full coverage of this hot topic for virtually every global 5000 organization, government agency, and individual interested in security.* Brian Contos is the Chief Security Officer for one of the most well known, profitable and respected security software companies in the U.S.—ArcSight.

Explora el crimen organizado, amenazas terroristas y hackers. Aborda las medidas que deben adoptar las organizaciones para hacer frente a las amenazas internas a nivel de personas, procesos y tecnología. Los titulares de hoy están llenos de noticias de ladrones de identidad, ciberdelincuentes organizados, espionaje corporativo, amenazas estatales nacionales y terroristas. title: Information Security Breaches: Avoidance and Treatment Based on ISO27001, 2nd Edition
description:
What if you suffer an information security breach?

Many titles explain how to reduce the risk of information security breaches. Nevertheless breaches do occur, even to organisations that have taken all reasonable precautions. Information Security Breaches - Avoidance and treatment based on ISO27001:2013 helps you to manage this threat by detailing what to do as soon as you discover a breach.

Be prepared, be prompt, be decisive

When your organisation’s security is compromised, you cannot afford to waste time deciding how to resolve the issue. You must be ready to take prompt and decisive action. Updated to cover ISO27001:2013, this second edition gives you clear guidance on how to treat an information security breach and tells you the plans and procedures you have to put in place to minimise damage and return to business as usual.

A recovery plan will help you to:

recover, and resume normal operations, more quickly
preserve customer confidence by quickly resolving service disruption
secure evidence to help with any criminal investigation and improve your chances of catching those responsible.

Read this guide and find out how to manage in the face of a data breach.

'…Michael Krausz has created a valuable tool … Written in plain English, this handbook is easy to follow even by a novice in the Information Technology Field. Therefore "Information Security Breaches" is a must within the 'tool box' of anyone who deals with IT issues on an every-day basis...' 

Werner Preining, Interpool Security Ltd

About the author

Michael Krausz is an IT expert and experienced professional investigator. He has investigated over a hundred cases of information security breaches. Many of these cases have concerned forms of white-collar crime. Michael Krausz studied physics, computer science and law at the University of Technology in Vienna, and at Vienna and Webster universities. He has delivered over 5000 hours of professional and academic training and has provided services in eleven countries to date.

title: The dotCrime Manifesto
description:
Internet crime keeps getting worse...but it doesn’t have to be that way. In this book, Internet security pioneer Phillip Hallam-Baker shows how we can make the Internet far friendlier for honest people–and far less friendly to criminals.

The dotCrime Manifesto begins with a revealing new look at the challenge of Internet crime–and a surprising look at today’s Internet criminals. You’ll discover why the Internet’s lack of accountability makes it so vulnerable, and how this can be fixed –technically, politically, and culturally.

Hallam-Baker introduces tactical, short-term measures for countering phishing, botnets, spam, and other forms of Internet crime. Even more important, he presents a comprehensive plan for implementing accountability-driven security infrastructure: a plan that draws on tools that are already available, and rapidly emerging standards and products. The result: a safer Internet that doesn’t sacrifice what people value most: power, ubiquity, simplicity, flexibility, or privacy.

Tactics and strategy: protecting Internet infrastructure from top to bottom

Building more secure transport, messaging, identities, networks, platforms, and more

Gaining safety without sacrificing the Internet’s unique power and value

Making the Internet safer for honest people without sacrificing ubiquity, simplicity, or privacy

Spam: draining the swamp, once and for all

Why spam contributes to virtually every form of Internet crime–and what we can do about it

Design for deployment: how to really make it happen

Defining security objectives, architecture, strategy, and design–and evangelizing them

How to Build a Safer, Better Internet

You’ll find yourself deeply concerned, then fascinated, then hopeful as you read about

•    Building an Internet that resists online crime

•    Phishing, botnets, and spam: tactical, workable, immediate countermeasures

•    Establishing the “Accountable Web”: a strategic, long-term solution to Internet crime

•    Improving security without sacrificing what people love about the Internet

The Internet is today’s Wild West: too much lawlessness, too little accountability. Now, one of the Internet’s leading pioneers shows how we can build a more trustworthy Internet: one that resists crime without frustrating honest people or compromising privacy and civil liberties. Drawing on years at the cutting edge of Internet and security research, Phillip Hallam-Baker offers a complete plan for reinventing the Internet: a plan that addresses everything from technology to politics and culture. Whether you’re a technology professional, policymaker, or citizen, this book will show you how we can make the Internet better, smarter, and above all, safer.

title: Retire Retirement
description: Good news: there is no need to retire. There is no need to pack up your desk or attend one more retirement party. Why? With the widening gap between the number of workers and the demand for talent, employers are looking to keep smart, productive workers in the workplace. The growing talent shortage will allow you to re-negotiate your relationship with "work." The question is how will you make the most of your new career options. By retreating from traditional 9-5 work or by exploring unconventional ways to stay a part of the workplace? The choice is yours, and "Retire Retirement" shows you how to think about what you want, and how to get it. In this conversational, optimistic book, you will learn how to negotiate the best work environment for you, how to work with different generations to get the most out of your job, and explore the great opportunities that lie ahead. This book will help you begin today to create the opportunities that fit your unique needs--now and in the years to come! Tamara J. Erickson is both a respected, McKinsey Award-winning author and popular and engaging storyteller. Her compelling views of the future are based on extensive research on changing demographics and employee values and, most recently, on how successful organizations work. She is President of The Concours Institute, the research and education arm of BSG Concours, a division of BSG Alliance Corp., and co-author of Workforce Crisis.
